caseStudies.title: VaultWise: AI-Powered DeFi Yield Optimizer
caseStudies.description: Building an AI-powered DeFi yield optimizer featuring ERC-4626 vaults, cross-chain swap aggregators, automated compounding agents, and autonomous AI rebalancing.

challenge.title: Fragmented Yield & Complex UX
challenge.description: DeFi users struggle to manually track yields, rebalance portfolios, and move assets across chains. The process is slow, gas-intensive, and requires constant monitoring.
bullets: Manual yield farming is time-consuming and inefficient.
Cross-chain liquidity management is fragmented.
Users miss out on optimal APY due to delayed rebalancing.

solution.title: Autonomous AI Yield Engine
solution.description: Invorious is building VaultWise—a DeFi-native platform that abstracts away the complexity. Users deposit into secure ERC-4626 vaults, and an AI agent autonomously rebalances positions across protocols like Uniswap, Aave, and Curve based on real-time APY and risk parameters.

features.title: ERC-4626 Vaults
features.description: Standardized, secure yield-bearing vaults for maximum composability.

features.title: Cross-Chain Aggregator
features.description: Seamless asset routing across multiple chains.

timeline.title: Architecture & Smart Contracts
timeline.description: Design ERC-4626 vaults, cross-chain aggregators, and governance tokenomics.

timeline.title: AI Agent Development
timeline.description: Build the autonomous agent logic for APY tracking and position rebalancing.

timeline.title: Frontend & Web3 Integration
timeline.description: Develop the dApp interface with Wagmi, RainbowKit, and real-time dashboards.

timeline.title: Audit & Launch
timeline.description: Conduct rigorous smart contract audits and deploy to mainnet.

testimonial.quote: VaultWise abstracts the complexity of DeFi. The AI agent handles the hard work, so users can just deposit and earn.
testimonial.name: VaultWise User

keyLearnings.title: Standardization is Key
keyLearnings.description: Using ERC-4626 ensures maximum compatibility with other DeFi protocols.

keyLearnings.title: AI Drives Efficiency
keyLearnings.description: Automated rebalancing outperforms manual yield farming by capturing opportunities instantly.

bottomCta.title: We're Building VaultWise
bottomCta.description: An AI-powered DeFi yield optimizer with secure vaults and autonomous agents.

caseStudies.title: Opportunity Intelligence Engine - Desktop Arbitrage Detection
caseStudies.description: A lightweight Windows desktop application that detects cross-game arbitrage opportunities across 15+ Web3 games in real-time-helping gamers and traders act instantly.
caseStudies.imageAlt: Opportunity Intelligence Engine - Desktop Arbitrage Detection

challenge.title: Fragmented Markets, Missed Opportunities
challenge.description: Web3 gamers and traders struggle to track price discrepancies across multiple games and marketplaces. Assets are scattered across Ronin, Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon-each with different liquidity, pricing, and timing dynamics.
bullets: Price differences across marketplaces are hard to spot manually
Manual verification takes minutes-opportunities close in seconds
No unified tool for cross-game asset tracking
Traders waste hours switching between wallets and exchanges

solution.title: Desktop Arbitrage Detection Engine
solution.description: Invorious built a lightweight Windows desktop application (.exe) that runs locally and continuously monitors 15+ Web3 games for arbitrage opportunities. The app displays real-time alerts and guided execution paths.

features.title: Live Price Monitoring
features.description: Tracks floor prices, liquidity, and trading volume across 15+ games simultaneously.

features.title: Cross-Market Arbitrage Detection
features.description: Identifies price discrepancies between Ronin, Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon.

features.title: Real-Time Desktop Alerts
features.description: Instant notifications when an opportunity is detected-no browser tab needed.

features.title: Multi-Chain Support
features.description: Supports Ethereum, Ronin, Solana, and Polygon-more chains in development.

features.title: Lightweight & Fast
features.description: Runs with minimal system resource usage.

timeline.title: Marketplace Integration
timeline.description: Connected to 15+ game marketplaces across 4 chains-Ronin, Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon.

timeline.title: Core Engine Development
timeline.description: Built cross-game arbitrage detection algorithms in C++ for optimal performance.

timeline.title: Desktop UI & Alerts
timeline.description: Designed a clean, intuitive interface with real-time notifications and guided execution paths.

timeline.title: Beta Release
timeline.description: Released as a Windows desktop application (.exe) with free beta access.

testimonial.quote: This desktop app changed how I trade Web3 assets. I get real-time alerts without having to keep browser tabs open all day.
testimonial.name: Beta User

keyLearnings.title: Desktop Apps Offer Speed & Privacy
keyLearnings.description: Running locally means faster detection and no reliance on web server availability. Data stays on the user's machine.

keyLearnings.title: Multi-Chain is Essential
keyLearnings.description: Price discrepancies exist across chains-not just marketplaces. Supporting Ronin, Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon was critical.

keyLearnings.title: Gamers Want Actionable Alerts
keyLearnings.description: Users don't want to monitor dashboards-they want real-time alerts that tell them exactly what to do.

You'll architect and implement critical systems including blockchain indexers, high-throughput API gateways, and secure cryptographic services.

openings.title: Project Manager (Web3 Initiatives)
openings.description: Coordinate the development team and ensure smooth delivery of Web3 projects. Own project planning, sprint coordination, and timeline management across engineering, design, and business stakeholders. Identify risks, track progress, and keep the team aligned.

qualifications: 3+ years in software engineering, with 1–2 years deep in the Web3 trenches (EVM required, Rust is a plus).
Language Agnostic: Highly proficient in Solidity and comfortable working with Vyper.
A Security Mindset: You dream in reentrancy attacks, understand upgradeable contract patterns, and know exactly how to prevent vulnerabilities.
Full-Stack Fluency: You’re comfortable in TypeScript, Node.js, and modern Web3 libraries (viem, wagmi).
Communication: You can explain a Merkle tree to a non-technical client without making them feel dumb.
Autonomy: You don't need to be micromanaged. You see a problem, you scope it, and you ship a solution.
responsibilities: Architect & Build: Design, develop, and deploy secure smart contracts primarily on EVM-compatible chains using Solidity and/or Vyper.
Tokenomics & Logic: Build out token systems (ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155), DeFi primitives, and dApp logic from scratch.
Security First: Write comprehensive tests and conduct internal audits using Hardhat, Foundry, or ApeWorX. You care about gas optimization and security.
Bridge the Gap: Work closely with our Web2 engineers to wire your contracts into slick, responsive frontends (Next.js, Wagmi, Viem).
Consult & Educate: Translate real-world business problems into decentralized solutions for clients who might not be Web3 natives.
applicationSteps: Forget the formal cover letter. Send us your GitHub, a 2-sentence note about the coolest (or most catastrophic) smart contract you’ve ever built, and the contract address of a real project you've deployed to mainnet.
Use email subject format: Smart Contract Engineer – [Your Name]
Email: hello@invorious.com

journey.title: Intro & Technical Chat (30 mins)
journey.description: A quick call with our founder to talk shop, culture, and what you're looking for. We'll also ask a few simple, practical technical questions to ensure we're on the same page before moving forward.

journey.title: Code Review / Take-Home (Paid)
journey.description: We will either give you a short, realistic take-home challenge or ask you to walk us through a past smart contract you've built.

journey.title: Technical Deep Dive (60 mins)
journey.description: A discussion with our engineers about architecture, security, and how you solve problems.

journey.title: Offer
journey.description: If we're a fit, we move fast.
